description: Use when an agent needs to know what is being liquidated right now. Returns the last 60 minutes across every USDT perp we record: total USD, long/short split, prints and the top 5 symbols. If our recording is stale it answers 503 and is never billed. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
